description.text:
Seven single attacks at Cap Break Level 1, grants Lv.2 En-Water, Lv.2 Earth or Lv.2 En-Holy Stack, Cap Break Level 1, Water/Earth/Holy Damage +30%, Quick Water/Earth/Holy & Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Water/Earth/Holy Damage +20% & Magic Casting Speed x1.1
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Water/Earth/Holy, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Law of the Eidolons+ II: 1.65s CT, 6 hits; Summoner's Band+: Higher multiplier & Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
